text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. This includes learning, problem-solving, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where systems improve by analysing data without being explicitly programmed for every step. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses layers of artificial neural networks to recognise complex patterns. Today, AI has many applications in daily life. It powers virtual assistants like Siri, recommends movies on streaming platforms, and helps self-driving cars navigate safely. These technologies are becoming increasingly common and are changing how we live and work.
